| [QUESTION-410](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-410.md) v2 | Have the DNA-origami folding-pathway and thermodynamic results that the record holds from single groups been reproduced independently: the order in which staple domains bind and the compacted intermediate, where folding nucleates under changed staple concentrations, the design aggregates that order defectivity, the asymmetric hysteresis and the nucleation barrier of domain-level models, and single-fold stability and blocking by excess staple? | The promotion conditions formerly on [THEORY-1441](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1441.md), [THEORY-1442](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1442.md), [THEORY-1446](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1446.md), [THEORY-1447](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1447.md), [THEORY-1453](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1453.md), [THEORY-1454](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1454.md), [THEORY-1457](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1457.md), moved here when the twenty-eighth status review promoted them under [ADR-065](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-065.md), and THEORY-1440's, moved when the twenty-ninth narrowed and promoted it. Each reading reports what one group found, among the record's DNA-origami folding-pathway and thermodynamic results; whether each holds when another group or method tests it is this question. | Open |
| [QUESTION-417](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-417.md) v2 | Do the primary studies behind Araki, Berejikian, Ford and Blouin's Table 1 bear out hatchery salmonids' relative fitness in the wild generally below one and lowest, at lifetime 0.02–0.37, for nonlocal segregated stocks, and does a reproduction of their Eqn (3) and Figs 2–3 show that on one trait a decline of more than 30% per generation needs strong truncation, high heritability and strong wild selection together? | The promotion condition formerly on [THEORY-1495](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1495.md), moved here when the twenty-eighth status review promoted it under [ADR-065](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-065.md). It read: 'Table 1 is checked against its sources and shows hatchery salmonids' relative fitness in the wild generally below one and lowest, at lifetime 0.02–0.37, for nonlocal segregated stocks; and Eqn (3) with Figs 2–3 is reproduced, showing that on one trait a decline of more than 30% per generation needs strong truncation, high heritability and strong wild selection together (LT ≤ 0.5, ω2 > 5 or h2 ≤ 0.2 each failing). The multi-trait half is filed as the authors' argument of plausibility and needs no computation beyond showing the paper makes it.' [THEORY-1495](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1495.md) reports what the review and its model find; whether its sources and its computation bear that out is this question. | Open |
| [QUESTION-419](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-419.md) | Have the DNA-origami design, quality and device results that the record holds from single groups been reproduced independently: the defects that TEM and gels miss, slow multilayer folding and its cation dependence, yield gains from optimized staple breakpoints, the logic-gated barrel's AND gate and lock-length dependence, repair from supplied staples, the folding loss from off-target-prone scaffold sequences, and the yields of scaffolded origami? | The promotion conditions formerly on [THEORY-1443](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1443.md), [THEORY-1444](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1444.md), [THEORY-1445](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1445.md), [THEORY-1450](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1450.md), [THEORY-1452](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1452.md), [THEORY-1455](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1455.md), [THEORY-1456](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1456.md), moved here when the twenty-eighth status review promoted them under [ADR-065](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-065.md). Each reading reports what one group found, among the record's DNA-origami design, quality and device results; whether each holds when another group or method tests it is this question. | Open |
| [QUESTION-423](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-423.md) | Does an independent derivation or computation, on a network other than Rocks and Mehta's two examples, confirm their generalized index theorem with prestress and heterogeneous stiffness, the identity of zero-displacement tensions with states of self-stress, the joint-symmetry rule for the forces that excite linear zero modes, and the redirection and localization of those forces by symmetry-breaking prestress? | The promotion condition formerly on [THEORY-1414](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1414.md), moved here when the twenty-eighth status review narrowed that reading to the paper's two worked networks and promoted it under [ADR-065](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-065.md). Rocks and Mehta prove the theorems and show the localization on a diamond network and a 4×4 periodic square lattice, both with uniform stiffness. A first computation on two other networks, second-checked, confirms the theorem, Theorem 1 and the localization; the symmetry rule is untested elsewhere. | Open |

| [QUESTION-431](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-431.md) v3 | Does an independent pooled analysis or large cohort of adult corticosteroid users, tested at least 24 hours after the last dose, reproduce the route ordering, the rise of adrenal suppression with dose and duration and a persisting fraction of about 15–25% weeks to months after stopping, and does a comparative trial show any withdrawal scheme effective or safe? | The independent test and the refutation clauses formerly in [THEORY-1513](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1513.md)'s promotion condition, moved here when the twenty-eighth status review promoted that reading as a report under [ADR-065](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-065.md). | Open |
| [QUESTION-445](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-445.md) | Does an experiment on a 2D DNA origami, resolving domains or staples during annealing, show that most staples bind fully soon after their first domain binds and that assembly proceeds without a measurable nucleation barrier? | The promotion condition formerly on [THEORY-1437](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1437.md), moved here when the thirtieth status review narrowed and promoted that reading under [ADR-065](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-065.md).
